description:
FREE and instant (no AI). Static migration-readiness scan of a VBScript file (.vbs, .wsf, HTA or classic ASP snippet) before Windows disables VBScript: lists COM objects used (FileSystemObject, WScript.Shell, ADODB, XMLHTTP, WMI, Outlook, Excel...) with their PowerShell equivalent, risky features (On Error Resume Next, Execute/Eval, SendKeys, registry, MsgBox), conversion traps (1-based strings, array bounds, case-sensitive comparisons, ByRef), blockers, security flags (hard-coded passwords, plain HTTP) and a 0-100 risk score with difficulty. Use it to triage many scripts before converting.

Pricing: free, no API key needed.
name: scan_vbscript
title: Scan VBScript for migration risks
